[[File:Hayes Hunter 2020 Volunteer Award.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Hayes Hunter with his 2020 Volunteer Award.]]
'''Hayes Hunter''' (GEMP handle '''hayes''') is a member of [[Team 5]] and the 2023 World Champion. He finished 3rd at the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="fc-home">[http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ FreedomCon home page], decktech.net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011201221615/http://decktech.net/freedomcon/ Internet Archive, 1 December 2001]</ref> [[Eric Hunter]] is his brother.<ref name="worlds24-wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-worlds-wrap-up-joe-olson-earns-third-championship-win/ 2024 Worlds Wrap-Up - Joe Olson Earns Third Championship Win], starwarsccg.org: &ldquo;Hayes&rsquo; award was presented by his brother Eric Hunter&rdquo;</ref> He flew to the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] at 14 with his family.<ref name="pds2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJuistFFk9M&t=1813s SWCCG PDS2: Hayes Hunter Worlds 2023 Champion Interview], BillBisco2 (10 May 2025), 30:13–32:30. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-qJuistFFk9M Internet Archive]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016010406/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qJuistFFk9M watch-page snapshot] (Wayback 16 October 2026).</ref> He played the [[2026 European Championship]].<ref name="pc-euro">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-10-european-championship-bochum-germany-sept-19-20-2026/ 2026-10 European Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
